scenarios.title: A｜主动道歉
scenarios.setting: 争吵结束后，玩家意识到自己刚才说了一些过分的话。

turns.text: Can we talk about what happened earlier?

turns.prompt: 你想为刚才的情况致歉或作些说明，会怎么说？

choices.text: I’m sorry for the way I spoke to you. I was upset, but that doesn’t excuse it.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m sorry for the way I spoke to you. I was upset, but that doesn’t excuse it.
feedback.explanation: 点明自己为什么致歉，比只说一句“sorry”更能让对方知道问题已被理解。

choices.text: I’ve been thinking about what I said, and I shouldn’t have said those things.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’ve been thinking about what I said, and I shouldn’t have said those things.
feedback.explanation: “I’ve been”把过去的经历或持续情况与现在联系起来，适合交代背景。

choices.text: I was frustrated, but I took it out on you. I’m sorry.

feedback.naturalExpression: I was frustrated, but I took it out on you. I’m sorry.
feedback.explanation: “I’m sorry”先表达歉意或遗憾，再说明具体情况，能照顾对方的感受。

choices.text: I still think we need to talk about the problem, but I could have handled it much better.

feedback.naturalExpression: I still think we need to talk about the problem, but I could have handled it much better.
feedback.explanation: 说明可以提供的行动或可行方案，让对话有明确的下一步。

choices.text: I’m sorry, but you made me really angry.

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: I’m sorry for the way I spoke to you. I was upset, but that doesn’t excuse it.
feedback.explanation: “but you made me”把道歉转成归责；先承担自己的行为，再另谈不满，更能让道歉成立。

turns.text: I was pretty hurt by what you said.

turns.prompt: 你想表示理解对方的解释或立场，会怎么说？

choices.text: I understand. You didn’t deserve to be spoken to like that.

feedback.naturalExpression: I understand. You didn’t deserve to be spoken to like that.
feedback.explanation: “I understand”承认听懂了对方的理由或难处，为继续协商提供基础。

choices.text: I know. I wish I could take it back.

feedback.naturalExpression: I know. I wish I could take it back.
feedback.explanation: “I wish I could take it back”表达希望能收回伤人的话，承认现实中已经说出口的遗憾。

choices.text: I’m sorry I hurt you. I’ll try not to react like that again.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m sorry I hurt you. I’ll try not to react like that again.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。

choices.text: I understand if you’re still upset with me.

feedback.naturalExpression: I understand if you’re still upset with me.
feedback.explanation: “I understand”承认听懂了对方的理由或难处，为继续协商提供基础。

turns.prompt: 关于「道歉与和好」，你想让对方了解你的需求或来意，会怎么说明？

choices.text: I mean it. I want to handle things differently next time.

feedback.naturalExpression: I mean it. I want to handle things differently next time.
feedback.explanation: “next time”把可能的参与留到下次，适合婉拒当下的邀请。

choices.text: Thanks for hearing me out.

feedback.naturalExpression: Thanks for hearing me out.
feedback.explanation: 感谢后面说明具体原因，让对方知道哪项帮助对自己有用。

scenarios.title: B｜接受道歉
scenarios.setting: 在“道歉与和好”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“接受道歉”。

turns.text: I’m sorry about yesterday. I shouldn’t have spoken to you like that.

turns.prompt: 你想回应对方的帮助或安排，表达谢意，会怎么说？

choices.text: Thank you for apologizing. I appreciate it.

feedback.naturalExpression: Thank you for apologizing. I appreciate it.
feedback.explanation: “I appreciate”表达对帮助、坦诚或付出的感谢，后面点明感谢对象更具体。

choices.text: I appreciate you saying that.

feedback.naturalExpression: I appreciate you saying that.
feedback.explanation: “I appreciate”表达对帮助、坦诚或付出的感谢，后面点明感谢对象更具体。

choices.text: I accept your apology. I know we were both upset.

feedback.naturalExpression: I accept your apology. I know we were both upset.
feedback.explanation: “I accept your apology”明确接受道歉，让对方知道这次解释已经被听见。

choices.text: Thank you. What happened did hurt me, but I’m glad we’re talking about it.

feedback.naturalExpression: Thank you. What happened did hurt me, but I’m glad we’re talking about it.
feedback.explanation: “I'm glad”表达自己的积极感受，适合回应好消息或说明一件事对自己的意义。

choices.text: It’s fine. Forget about it.

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: Thank you for apologizing. I appreciate it.
feedback.explanation: “Forget about it”让话题结束；如果自己仍介意，说明还需要时间比假装没事更准确。

turns.text: I don’t want us to fight like that again.

turns.prompt: 关于「道歉与和好」，你想提出一个接下来的做法或安排，会怎么建议？

choices.text: Neither do I. Maybe we can handle it differently next time.

feedback.naturalExpression: Neither do I. Maybe we can handle it differently next time.
feedback.explanation: “next time”把可能的参与留到下次，适合婉拒当下的邀请。

choices.text: Me neither. I think we both need to communicate before things build up.

feedback.naturalExpression: Me neither. I think we both need to communicate before things build up.
feedback.explanation: “I think”把话说成个人判断，为讨论留出空间；后面的具体理由才是沟通重点。

choices.text: I agree. I’d rather talk about problems earlier.

feedback.naturalExpression: I agree. I’d rather talk about problems earlier.
feedback.explanation: 把选择说成自己的偏好，可以表明立场，而不必否定另一种选择。

choices.text: We might still disagree sometimes, but we don’t have to hurt each other.

feedback.naturalExpression: We might still disagree sometimes, but we don’t have to hurt each other.
feedback.explanation: “have to”表示有必要或受条件限制必须这样做，可用于核实办理要求。

turns.text: Yeah. I think we can do better.

turns.prompt: 你想表达认同或相似的感受，会怎么说？

choices.text: I think so too.

feedback.naturalExpression: I think so too.
feedback.explanation: “I think”把话说成个人判断，为讨论留出空间；后面的具体理由才是沟通重点。

choices.text: I’m glad we talked about it.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m glad we talked about it.
feedback.explanation: “I'm glad”表达自己的积极感受，适合回应好消息或说明一件事对自己的意义。

choices.text: Come here. We’re okay.

feedback.naturalExpression: Come here. We’re okay.
feedback.explanation: 直接交代自己当前的状态或安排，能让对方据此继续交流。

scenarios.title: C｜仍然需要时间
scenarios.setting: 在“道歉与和好”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“仍然需要时间”。

turns.text: I’m really sorry about what happened. Can we just put it behind us?

turns.prompt: 关于「道歉与和好」，你想让对方了解你的需求或来意，会怎么说明？

choices.text: I appreciate the apology, but I’m still hurt and I need some time.

feedback.naturalExpression: I appreciate the apology, but I’m still hurt and I need some time.
feedback.explanation: “I appreciate”表达对帮助、坦诚或付出的感谢，后面点明感谢对象更具体。

choices.text: Thank you for apologizing. I’m just not ready to move past it yet.

feedback.naturalExpression: Thank you for apologizing. I’m just not ready to move past it yet.
feedback.explanation: 感谢后面说明具体原因，让对方知道哪项帮助对自己有用。

choices.text: I want us to work things out, but I need some space first.

feedback.naturalExpression: I want us to work things out, but I need some space first.
feedback.explanation: “need some space”表示需要个人空间或暂时分开冷静，能说明需求而不评价对方这个人。

choices.text: I’m glad you’re sorry, but I don’t think I can pretend everything is fine yet.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m glad you’re sorry, but I don’t think I can pretend everything is fine yet.
feedback.explanation: “I don’t think”把不同意见表达为自己的判断，而不是直接断定对方错误。

choices.text: Sorry isn’t enough. Leave me alone.

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: I appreciate the apology, but I’m still hurt and I need some time.
feedback.explanation: 需要独处可以直接表达；“Leave me alone”语气强烈，若只是暂时冷静，可明确说需要一点时间。

turns.text: Are you saying you don’t want to be together anymore?

turns.prompt: 关于「道歉与和好」，你想让对方了解你的需求或来意，会怎么说明？

choices.text: No. I’m saying I need some time to process what happened.

feedback.naturalExpression: No. I’m saying I need some time to process what happened.
feedback.explanation: 直接说明必要的需求，便于对方了解要解决什么；配合具体内容，比只说需要帮忙更清楚。

choices.text: I’m not making any decisions right now. I just need some space.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m not making any decisions right now. I just need some space.
feedback.explanation: “need some space”表示需要个人空间或暂时分开冷静，能说明需求而不评价对方这个人。

choices.text: I still care about you. I just don’t feel ready to talk normally yet.

feedback.naturalExpression: I still care about you. I just don’t feel ready to talk normally yet.
feedback.explanation: “I still care about”直接表达在意，有助于说明分歧并不抹去关心。

choices.text: Please don’t pressure me to decide anything right now.

feedback.naturalExpression: Please don’t pressure me to decide anything right now.
feedback.explanation: 把需要的行动明确说出来，并用礼貌用语缓和请求；对方能直接回应能否做到。

turns.text: Okay. How much time do you need?

turns.prompt: 你想说明自己需要一点独处或缓冲时间，会怎么说？

choices.text: I’m not sure. Can we talk again tomorrow?

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m not sure. Can we talk again tomorrow?
feedback.explanation: 用问句确认自己能否这样做，既说明所需动作，也让对方有机会解释限制。

choices.text: Maybe just tonight. I’d like some time by myself.

feedback.naturalExpression: Maybe just tonight. I’d like some time by myself.
feedback.explanation: “by myself”表示独自一人；可用来交代有没有同行者或能否独立完成。

choices.text: Give me a little time, and I’ll reach out when I’m ready.

feedback.naturalExpression: Give me a little time, and I’ll reach out when I’m ready.
feedback.explanation: “reach out”表示主动联系或寻求支持，常用于邀请对方以后再来沟通。

choices.text: I don’t know exactly, but I’ll let you know.

feedback.naturalExpression: I don’t know exactly, but I’ll let you know.
feedback.explanation: “I don't know”如实说明不清楚，避免把猜测说成确定的信息。

turns.text: Okay. I’ll give you some space.

turns.prompt: 你想回应对方的帮助或安排，表达谢意，会怎么说？

choices.text: Thank you. I appreciate that.

feedback.naturalExpression: Thank you. I appreciate that.
feedback.explanation: “I appreciate”表达对帮助、坦诚或付出的感谢，后面点明感谢对象更具体。

choices.text: Thanks. I’ll talk to you when I’m ready.

feedback.naturalExpression: Thanks. I’ll talk to you when I’m ready.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。
